name: HIWIN BK20-C3
description: Complete purchased precision support; internal supplier assembly remains opaque.

geometryEvidence.summary: Source B03TE03-1907 pp14/15; published housing, mounting/journal, nominal bearing and collar/locknut interfaces.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Axial internal stack, seal/rolling-contact detail and lid contours are illustrative. BF source omits axial drilling pitch and has a four-drill callout versus two visible top mounts; order drawing acceptance is required. C3/P5 is the requested execution to match a C3 ground screw, not a delivered certificate.

specifications.label: Bearing class
specifications.value: Request C3/P5 support execution to match the C3 ground screw, with measured runout and bearing preload; verify the delivered certificate and factory-approved assembly drawing.
